kareem_dropped_course.rationale: Real enrollment record: course_id=1, grade=45.0, status=DROPPED. A plan generated up front (decomposition-first) has no way to react to this -- it would blindly assume course 1 is satisfied or ignore it. Dynamic decomposition, which observes each sub-task's real result before generating the next one, is the only method that can notice the drop and insert a retake before anything depending on it.
